issues.title: Malawian of Asian origin arrested with R40,000 at airport
issues.title_en: Malawian of Asian origin arrested with R40,000 at airport
issues.summary: A 37-year-old Malawian of Asian origin has been arrested at Bakili Muluzi International Airport, formerly Chileka Airport, after he was allegedly found with R40,000 in foreign currency without the required supporting documents. Suhel Shirajamed Gangat, a teacher by profession, was arrested while preparing to travel to South Africa, airport police spokesperson Dorrah Machila Chathyoka has […]

issues.title: Why are Egypt and Ethiopia clashing over Tigray, Somalia and the Nile?
issues.title_en: Why are Egypt and Ethiopia clashing over Tigray, Somalia and the Nile?
issues.summary: Egypt expelled an official at the Ethiopian Embassy in Cairo on Thursday following a similar move by Ethiopia that same day, in the latest sign of tensions between the neighboring African countries.
